 "rationale": "The low-gain diode-loaded preamp (gain ~2-3) never saturates, so it does not need overload recovery. A mirror-loaded NMOS second stage gives high gain into a tiny node: only small inverter gates load it. A min-length inverter drives 50 fF rail-to-rail. Budget is IREF (~2 uA) plus 4 uA and 4 uA tails, about 18 uW, under 24.4 uW. Stage-1 CM is about 0.8 V, which leaves headroom for the stage-2 NMOS pair and tail."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in1": (18, 10, 24),     # preamp input pair gm/Id
    "gmid_ld1": (8, 4, 14),       # preamp PMOS diode loads gm/Id (sets gain & CM)
    "gmid_in2": (16, 8, 22),      # stage-2 input pair gm/Id
    "I1": (4e-6, 1.5e-6, 6e-6),   # preamp tail current
    "I2": (4e-6, 1.5e-6, 6e-6),   # stage-2 tail current
    "Lin": (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),      # input-pair length
    "Lb": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # bias mirror length
    "Wn_inv": (0.5, 0.42, 2.0),   # inverter nfet width
    "Wp_inv": (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),   # inverter pfet width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 2e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    I1, I2 = p["I1"], p["I2"]
    gmid_b = 12.0

    # bias mirror (all same L, gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], I1, vds=0.25)
    mt2 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], I2, vds=0.2)

    # stage 1: NMOS pair, PMOS diode loads
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in1"], p["Lin"], I1 / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld1"], 0.5, I1 / 2, vds=0.9)
    vcm1 = 1.8 - m3.vgs

    # stage 2: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in2"], p["Lin"], I2 / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, I2 / 2, vds=m3.vgs if False else 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT1", "t1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt1)
    n.dev("MT2", "t2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt2)
    # stage 1 (vinp high -> o1m low, o1p high)
    n.dev("M1", "o1m", "vinp", "t1", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1p", "vinn", "t1", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "o1m", "o1m", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1p", "o1p", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # stage 2: diode on M6 side, output on M5 side (o1p high -> o2 low)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1p", "t2", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "d6", "o1m", "t2", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "d6", "d6", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "o2", "d6", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # output inverter (o2 low -> vout high)
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn_inv"], 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp_inv"], 0.15)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m3.gm + m3.gds + m1.gds)
    vd1 = 2 * vod * A1                      # stage-1 differential swing
    c1 = m5.cgg + m3.cgg + 2 * m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    t1 = c1 * vd1 / max(m1.gm * vod, 1e-9)  # linear ramp of stage 1
    di2 = min(I2, m5.gm * vd1)              # stage-2 steered current
    c2 = m5.cdd + m7.cdd + m5.cgd + 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn_inv"] + p["Wp_inv"]) / 0.5 * 0.5 + 1e-15
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / max(di2, 1e-9)
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / 150e-6
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = 1.8 * (iref + I1 + I2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "vcm1": vcm1, "gain1": A1}
